source_chain: __memcg_slab_free_hook frees an accounted slab object and calls __refill_obj_stock(objcg, stock, obj_size, true)
__refill_obj_stock accumulates freed object bytes; when allow_uncharge and accumulated bytes exceed PAGE_SIZE it computes nr_pages = stock_nr_bytes >> PAGE_SHIFT
obj_cgroup_uncharge_pages resolves the memcg and calls refill_stock(memcg, nr_pages)
for the captured specimen nr_pages == 1, producing exactly one page of target memcg stock

resolved_provenance.emitter_context: systemd PID1 receiving a UNIX datagram and freeing skb memory
resolved_provenance.physical_state_chain: systemd recvmsg -> skb free -> memcg slab free hook -> objcg one-page uncharge -> refill_stock(owner_memcg,1) -> S0=1 -> T=2
